summary: Residential kerb where cars park, but homes 13 m away and a steep grade.

best_section.where: North kerb of Marmion Parade, under the tree canopy mid-stretch

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings about 13 m from the kerb at 18 m and 9 m at 40 m; apartments across the road at 18-22 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both sides; room at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 2P parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 6.5% over the section, 18.7% max on the stretch
sun_shade: Large tree canopy shades the kerb from the north.
